scheduled_class_clock.name: scheduled_class_clock
scheduled_class_clock.value:
extract(second from "scheduled_class"."start_time") = 0
        and extract(minute from "scheduled_class"."start_time")::int % 5 = 0
        and (extract(hour from "scheduled_class"."start_time") * 60 + extract(minute from "scheduled_class"."start_time") + "scheduled_class"."duration_minutes") <= 1440

week_template_row_clock.name: week_template_row_clock

extract(second from "week_template_row"."start_time") = 0
        and extract(minute from "week_template_row"."start_time")::int % 5 = 0
        and (extract(hour from "week_template_row"."start_time") * 60 + extract(minute from "week_template_row"."start_time") + "week_template_row"."duration_minutes") <= 1440

organization_custom_domain_format.name: organization_custom_domain_format
organization_custom_domain_format.value:
"organization"."custom_domain" is null or (
        "organization"."custom_domain" = lower("organization"."custom_domain")
        and char_length("organization"."custom_domain") between 1 and 253
        and "organization"."custom_domain" !~ '://'
        and "organization"."custom_domain" ~ $1
        and "organization"."custom_domain" <> 'studio-desk.axondigital.xyz'
        and "organization"."custom_domain" !~ '\.studio-desk\.axondigital\.xyz$'
      )
